text:
Anya: kicked off a Longarm bring-up for magnet24k (int4). target context 65,536, prefill ~55k. seeing a small repeating-echo when prefill crosses ~48k, dumping quick logs here.
Ken: pastebin for raw run: https://internal.redwood/pastes/longarm-1711211133 
Sam: repro command I used:
```
./run_longarm --model magnet24k --quant int4 --context-window 65536 --prefill 55000 --enable-rope-scaling --batch 1
```
Marta: behaviour: tokens 3..6 after boundary repeat a fragment of the system prompt, sometimes 3 tokens, sometimes 5. not random, looks like a cache re-read.
Devon: initial bisect -> discrepancy between float/FP32 rope-phase scale and int4 kernel. int4 path has a micro-clamp in rotary_impl that nudges phase by ~+1.2e-4 at large strides.
Anya: quick log excerpt (sanitized):
```
[longarm] prefill=54990 window_end=54990
[rope] phase_scale=(float)0.999985 (int4)1.000120
[decode] repeating token ids: [104, 105, 104]
```
Ken: also saw a minor kvcache eviction spike just after the boundary, latency +30-80ms. link to flame: https://internal.redwood/flame/1711211133
Sam: hypothesis: tiled-shard index off-by-one + soft-eviction leads to stale KV reads that get merged back into the stream when rope scaling differs.
Marta: tried a mitigation: prefix-snapshotting at 16k intervals prevents repeats (perf hit ~+6%).
Devon: pushed a small patch (dev/rope-softclamp-171121) to harmonize scaling between kernels and to add a guard for tile indices. running smoke for 56k prefill now.
ci-bot: longarm-smoke (dev/rope-softclamp-171121) — FAILED — regression=repeat-echo (1)
Devon: failure reproduces in smoke; logs show tile-index wrap at tile=3 and a subsequent KV read from negative offset (looks like signed->unsigned cast issue).
Ken: tokenizer diff looks normal, but token alignment changes by +1 at the boundary for some sequences. I'll push the diff to the paste.
Sam: workaround notes: running with --prefill-snapshot=16384 or enabling the kvcache hard-flush at 48k avoids the echo. Not a long-term fix.
Anya: action items:
- Devon: follow up on signed->unsigned index fix + soft-clamp refinement. add unit test for tile-index wrap.
- Sam: run parameter sweep for snapshot breakpoints (16k/24k/32k/48k) and measure perf/quality tradeoff.
- Ken: gather LFU/eviction stats and tokenizer diffs for next three runs.
- Marta: create a focused eval (longprefix-echo-goldset) to assert no repeats on gold prompts.
Devon: noted; adding svt/longarm test asserting "no triple-repeat" for prefill=48k..56k. will ping when CI passes.
Anya: thanks — keep updates concise here. :thumbsup:
